select * from ( SELECT a.company_id companyId, a.company_name companyName, DATE_FORMAT( a.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d ' ) createDate, tmp.collect_time_num collectTimeNum, tmp.collect_day_time_num collectDayTimeNum, tmpa.valid_duration validDuration, tmpa.user_num userNum, tmpa.used_mach_num usedMachNum, tmpb.valid_mach_num validMachNum, tmpc.total_mach_num totalMachNum FROM comm_company a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_id, sum(mach_coll_second) collect_time_num, sum(mach_coll_days) collect_day_time_num FROM ( SELECT company_id, mach_sn, sum( TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, ecg_start_time, ecg_end_time ) ) mach_coll_second, count( date_format(ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) mach_coll_days FROM cust_user_ecg_rec WHERE date_format(ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate} AND date_format(ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate} GROUP BY company_id, mach_sn, date_format(ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) ta GROUP BY ta.company_id ) tmp ON a.company_id = tmp.company_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.company_id, sum(b.valid_duration) valid_duration, count(DISTINCT(user_id)) user_num, count(DISTINCT(mach_sn)) used_mach_num FROM cust_user_ecg_rec b WHERE date_format( b.ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= #{startDate} AND date_format( b.ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY b.company_id ) tmpa ON a.company_id = tmpa.company_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_id, count(*) valid_mach_num FROM comm_company_mach WHERE now() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date GROUP BY company_id ) tmpb ON a.company_id = tmpb.company_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_id, count(DISTINCT(mach_sn)) total_mach_num FROM comm_company_mach GROUP BY company_id ) tmpc ON a.company_id = tmpc.company_id )temp where 1=1
and ${key} like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
order by ${column} ${order}
order by companyId desc

select * from ( SELECT c.company_name companyName, u.user_name userName, sum( TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, r.ecg_start_time, r.ecg_end_time ) ) dataSeconds, count( DISTINCT ( DATE_FORMAT( r.ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) ) dataDays FROM `cust_user_ecg_rec` r LEFT JOIN cust_userinfo u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN comm_company c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT( r.ecg_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} GROUP BY r.user_id, r.company_id ORDER BY c.company_name, r.user_id )temp where 1=1
and ${key} like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
order by ${column} ${order}
order by companyName asc,dataDays desc,dataSeconds desc

SELECT COUNT(*) userNum, SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.node_full_name, '/', 1) areaName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(node_path, '/', 1) areaCode, ( SELECT count(*) FROM cust_userinfo ) total FROM cust_userinfo a LEFT JOIN comm_area b ON a.area_id = b.area_id GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.node_path, '/', 1)
